title: Invocation Specifier: compact parameter schema, validation modes, and error telemetry
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Define and implement a compact invocation specifier format (a small JSON manifest) for function/tool calls, plus three validation modes and an error/telemetry taxonomy. Goal: provide a machine-friendly, stable parameter schema that is cheap to validate at runtime, supports graceful compatibility with older clients, and emits clear, actionable telemetry for operator debugging and alerting. This ticket captures the spec, runtime integration points, and rollout plan for the validation and telemetry pieces.
acceptance_criteria: A compact invocation schema format (<= 1KB typical) is documented and published in the developer RFC
Runtime implements three validation modes: strict, permissive, and coerce-with-warnings
Validation errors are classified with stable error codes (INV_*), and client-facing messages are localized to be user-actionable
Telemetry emitted for every invocation containing validation_mode, error_code (if any), parameter_path samples, coercion applied, and validation latency
Backward-compatible adapter for legacy SDK v1 available that maps legacy param names and shapes to the spec
Automated unit and integration tests cover edge cases: missing required fields, extra fields, type mismatch, nested arrays, streaming partial payloads
technical_notes: Schema format: lightweight JSON manifest using a shallow 'params' shape: name -> {type, required? (bool), deprecated?: string, normalize?: rule_id}
Supported types: string, integer, number, boolean, object, array, enum, file_ref. No arbitrary regex-capable constraints in runtime (reserved for offline linting).
Validation modes: strict (reject on first error), permissive (accept but tag INVALID_* telemetry), coerce-with-warnings (attempt safe coercions; emit INV_COERCION_WARN)
Error taxonomy: INV_MISSING_REQUIRED, INV_TYPE_MISMATCH, INV_EXTRA_TOPFIELD, INV_DEPRECATED_FIELD_USED, INV_MALFORMED_JSON, INV_COERCION_WARN, INV_SCHEMA_PARSE_FAIL

Telemetry payload: {invocation_id, route, model, validation_mode, error_code, param_path, raw_sample (truncated), coercion_applied, validation_ms, outcome}, sampled at 1% by default and 100% for P0 customer routes

Streaming interactions: allow incremental parameter collection (partial bodies) — validation runs on 'parameter commit' event; streaming tokens include validation status updates in structured response envelope

Compatibility layer: runtime registers adapters per 'compat_profile' (legacy_v1, legacy_v2). Adapter maps old field names -> spec names and supplies shallow transformations; adapter failures surface as INV_EXTRA_TOPFIELD or INV_MALFORMED_JSON depending on error
Performance: validation loop optimized for common shapes using precompiled checks; expected median validation latency < 0.5ms for 95% of requests under load.
implementation_plan: Draft RFC describing invocation spec grammar and validation modes (link in links). Collect feedback from SDK and Console teams.
Add schema parser to runtime config loader: accepts compact manifest and compiles a small validator function per route.
Implement validation hook: pre-routing step that runs compiled validator with chosen validation_mode. Validator returns (ok, warnings, errors, coercions_applied).
Wire telemetry producer: small event emitted from validation hook. Add sampling controls and redaction of sensitive param values (PII filter).
Create compatibility adapters for legacy_v1 and legacy_v2 in 'compat' package; register via route config.
Add feature flag 'invocation-spec-validation' and a canary rollout path using runtime tags and console toggles.
Document developer-facing error codes and suggested remediation messages in the developer docs.
test_plan: Unit tests for compiled validators covering type coercions, required/optional semantics, enum checking
Integration tests: end-to-end function call with runtime validation in all three modes using a test model and mock tool endpoint
Property-based fuzzing: random param shapes to ensure validator does not crash and errors are classified
Streaming tests: simulate partial parameter streams and verify validation runs on commit and that partial streaming responses include validation markers
Backward compatibility tests: run legacy_v1 SDK mapping through adapter and assert identical effective param map for 95% of historical fixtures
Load test: runtime validation under 95th percentile production load to measure median and p95 validation latency impact
rollout_notes: Phase 1 (Canary): enable validation for internal routes and 5% of paid hosted routes. Collect telemetry and ensure no regression in latency SLOs.
Phase 2 (Gradual): enable coerce-with-warnings for public dev routes; surface warning messages in Console and SDK logs.
Phase 3 (Enforce): flip strict mode for high-confidence first-party routes after running compatibility reports and adapter fixes; keep permissive default for low-tier customers for 30 days
Rollback plan: feature flag off; fallback to legacy param pass-through if adapters fail. Alerting on spike in INV_MALFORMED_JSON or INV_SCHEMA_PARSE_FAIL.
Dashboard: add 'Invocation Validation' tile showing error rate by route, noisy param paths, and top coercions applied
monitoring_and_telemetry: Emit validation events to telemetry stream with schema described in technical_notes
Create quick alerts: >0.5% INV_TYPE_MISMATCH over 5m on high-volume routes
Create weekly job to run compatibility_report that compares incoming shapes against registered spec and produces a list of top mismatches for SDK team
Store redacted raw_sample for a short retention (7 days) to support debugging, drop for PII-marked params
